topic: Depositing a Check at the Bank

script.title: DEPOSITING A BIG CHECK
script.story_hook: A refund check meets a Monday rent deadline.
script.intro_zh: 一張退稅支票，撞上星期一要繳的房租。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're depositing a check and learning bank talk.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天我們來存支票，順便學銀行用語。
script.outro: And that's today's episode! One more round of listening, then see you!
script.outro_zh: 今天的節目就到這裡！再聽一輪，然後我們再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's read along together — every single line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起來照著唸——每一句都不放過。
script.char_a_description: a laid-back Black man in his early thirties with a low fade haircut and trimmed beard, a brown suede jacket over a grey hoodie, cheerfully swinging a paper check between two fingers
script.char_b_description: a poised Middle Eastern woman in her late twenties with dark wavy hair tied in a neat low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings, a crisp white blouse under a bank-issued navy vest, handling forms with quick practiced motions
script.youtube_title: 【🏦💵存支票實景】「背面簽名了嗎？」大額保留款怎麼問？聽完就懂銀行行話｜🧾Depositing A Check English
script.youtube_title_en: “Did You Sign the Back?” — Depositing a Check at the Bank
script.youtube_description:
第一次拿支票到銀行存，怕簽錯地方，也怕款項遭行員保留？這段櫃檯對話完整演練：背面簽名、大額支票保留款、先放一部分出來用，還有手機存稅額上限。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Depositing your first paper check can feel like a test you didn't study for. This teller-counter dialogue covers it all: endorsing the back, holds on large checks, releasing cash early, and mobile deposit limits — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and go to the bank with confidence.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💵存支票英文｜背面簽名・大額保留・手機存款｜聽完就會跑銀行｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
拿到一張支票，卻不敢自己進銀行存？
「保留款」三個字一出現，到底該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進銀行的櫃檯，跟著客戶從簽名背書、確認存入帳戶，到遇上大額支票保留、請行員先放五萬塊出來，最後還問了手機存票，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 存入與簽名：例如「I'd like to deposit this check.」、「Did you sign the back already?」。
⏳ 大額保留款：例如「Just so you know, we hold part of it.」、「I can release five hundred today.」。
📱 手機存票與收據：例如「Can I do this by app?」、「Sure, up to five hundred.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，領到支票的那天，你可以自己走進銀行，從從容容辦完。
script.thumbnail_action: signing the back of a paper check at the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! I'd like to deposit this check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪd laɪk tə dɪˈpɑzɪt ðɪs tʃɛk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning! Checking or savings today?
dialogue.zh: 早安！今天要存到活存還是儲蓄？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checking, please. And here's my debit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛkɪŋ pliːz ænd hɪrz maɪ ˈdɛbɪt kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 存活存，謝謝。這是我的金融卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Did you sign the back already?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks dɪd ju saɪn ðə bæk ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問您在背面簽名了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I didn't! Should I do it now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ dɪdnt ʃʊd aɪ du ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我還沒！現在補簽可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just your usual signature back there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒʌst jɔr ˈjuʒəəl ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ bæk ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把平常的簽名寫在後面就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy fix… there we go, all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi fɪks ðɛr wi ɡoʊ ɔl dʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. It's nine hundred — that's a big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ɪts naɪn ˈhʌndrəd ðæts ə bɪɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 很好。九百塊——金額還不小呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's my tax refund. Finally!
dialogue.zh: 是啊，是我的退稅。終於來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! Just so you know, we hold part of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs dʒʌst soʊ ju noʊ wi hoʊld pɑrt əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！不過先說明，我們會保留一部分款項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hold? I need to pay rent Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊld aɪ nid tə peɪ rɛnt ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 保留？可是我星期一要繳房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, I can release five hundred today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ kæn rɪˈlis faɪv ˈhʌndrəd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣吧，我今天可以先放五百塊給你用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would honestly save my whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd ˈɑnəstli seɪ maɪ hoʊl wik/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，那等於救了我整個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Everything going straight into checking?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈɡoʊɪŋ streɪt ˈɪntə ˈtʃɛkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。全部直接進活存帳戶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! By the way, can I do this by app?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs baɪ ðə weɪ kæn aɪ du ðɪs baɪ æp/
dialogue.zh: 對！對了，以後可以用手機存嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, up to five hundred. I'll show you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ʌp tə faɪv ˈhʌndrəd aɪl ʃoʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 可以，五百塊以內都行。我教你怎麼做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, thanks. Can I get a receipt too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt θæŋks kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə rɪˈsit tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝。可以再給我一張收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All printed. Have a wonderful week!
dialogue.zh: 收據印好了。祝你這週愉快！
